source: 2013/TSB Vol 13 No 02 New Dipstick Adapter Upgrade Kit.pdf
title: Dipstick Adapter Upgrade Kit
lead: MOC has created an upgrade kit for the Dipstick Service Adapter (Part No. 94777). The Kit (Part No. 94845), which includes 2 new dipstick service hoses in 1/4" and 5/16" that are connected by a quick disconnect fitting, and the Female Quick Disconnect Coupler to add to the existing Dipstick Service Adapter as shown in the pictures below, is now available for purchase.
body: NOTE: You will also need to request a Software update for the Smart Tech™ ATF Machine from the Machine and Equipment Department.
TO UPDATE YOUR EXISTING DIPSTICK SERVICE ADAPTER:
steps: Remove the brass fitting from the 3-Way manifold.
Apply Teflon tape to the Female Quick Disconnect Coupler (Part No. 94561) and connect it to the 3-Way manifold in the same location you removed the original brass fitting.
The adapter is now ready to be used. When performing a service, select the Dipstick Service Hose you want to use, 94839 or 94841, and connect it to the Female Coupler.
